claim: --pose-source reconstruct reproduces the v2ep-built B1 EVAL join BYTE FOR BYTE. The pose source changed and the output did not.
why_it_matters: read_raw_poses needs *.v2ep.pt; the B1 TRAIN epcache is ~161 GB (34 MB/episode x 4,713) and lives on Thor, not this box. The join reads exactly one [T,4] pose array (~6 KB) out of each 34 MB record. Reconstructing it from {clip}.timestamps.parquet + egomotion removes the blocker entirely.
method: the SAME builder, the SAME 141 EVAL clips, the SAME obstacle parquets; only --pose-source changed (v2ep -> reconstruct, with --n-stack 3 supplied because a reconstructed clip carries no record to read it from). No lead block was passed: the gate used the per-clip camera-grid reference.
upstream_pose_crosscheck: .../2026-09-02-b1-eval-lead-block/raw/grid_crosscheck.json reports max_dxy_m 0.0, max_dyaw_deg 0.0, max_dv_mps 0.0 on 20/20 clips (float32-identical), which is the per-clip pose proof this whole-artifact reproduction confirms end to end.
